verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Lovable command-line tool. The pack covers other surfaces: an MCP server, a REST API, a desktop app, mobile apps, Slack and Telegram bots, and Git sync for local IDE work. None of these is a first-party CLI, and adjacent interfaces earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
